name: GeneratedChart
description: A bar or line chart an assistant produced, drawn without a chart library, always with a written summary and a View as table switch that shows the same numbers as a table.

data.description: The labels along the bottom and one or more named series of values.

summary.description: A sentence that tells the story of the chart. Defaults to the highest and lowest values of the first series.

keyboard: Tab: moves to the View as table button
Arrow keys: move through the data table once it is shown
requirements: The drawing is decoration; the title, the written summary and the data table carry the meaning
View as table swaps in the same data as an accessible table (aria-pressed on the switch)
Series differ by marker shape or label as well as color, and a legend names them
Values are labelled directly when there are few bars
Empty data shows a message instead of an empty frame
screenReader: Announced as a figure named by the title, then the summary text
"View as table, toggle button, not pressed"
The table reads every value under its row and column headers

use_when: Showing trends or comparisons an assistant calculated
avoid_when: Dashboards with many linked charts: use a charting library
Exact numbers matter most: show a GeneratedTable
anti_patterns: Telling series apart by color only
